key_insight: WanPE is a large-scale prompt enhancement model that turns a simple text prompt into a more cinematic, director-style plan for modern text-to-video generation. It helps video models better handle long, multi-shot scenes by enriching prompts with detailed instructions for action, camera movement, lighting, and sound.
problem_solved: Text-to-video systems can generate longer videos, but plain prompts often lack the structure needed to control complex cinematic details across multiple shots. This paper addresses the gap between simple user prompts and the rich, production-style planning required for high-quality video generation.
method: Trained a 397B-parameter prompt enhancement model, WanPE, on 1.05M real-world videos.
Learns to expand basic prompts into cinematic screenplay-like instructions covering actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound.
Targets long-form, condition-following video generation where detailed prompt planning is critical.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, WanPE offers a practical way to improve prompt quality before generation, which can boost controllability and consistency in text-to-video workflows. It is especially relevant for building more reliable creative tools for long, cinematic, and multi-scene video generation.
